Pixar’s Elio isn’t just about a boy lost in space — it’s a blueprint of spiritual confusion wrapped in childlike wonder. From demonic sigils to Aleister Crowley ideology, Elio normalizes communicating with demons in the shape of an ouroboros, practicing sigils (magic) and befriending aliens, which, as you will see, are literally demons. He even surrounds himself with crystals, hanging out in a crystal circle, so that the aliens can abduct him. And this is supposed to be a kids' movie? Tune in and check it out for yourself.
